messages:
From: Anita Singh <anita@freshcart.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Quick eval request — Hosted API sandbox access

Hi Soojin,

We just signed up for a self-serve quick eval on your Hosted API and would love to do a short 30-minute walkthrough this week. FreshCart is evaluating integration options for checkout personalization (server-side calls from our backend). We completed the sign-up but want a short run-through to confirm sandbox access, IP allow-listing, and expected latency for 128-token responses.

Our team is small — it will be me (product) and our engineering lead. We're on EDT. Available windows:
- Mon 5/24 10:30–11:00am EDT
- Tue 5/25 2:00–2:30pm EDT
- Wed 5/26 9:00–9:30am EDT

Two quick asks:
1) Can you provision a temporary sandbox API key and a minimal quota (we want to run a few test calls before the call)?
2) Is there a short preflight checklist we should complete before the call?

Thanks — would appreciate a calendar invite if one of the slots works.

— Anita
Anita Singh
Product Manager, FreshCart
anita@freshcart.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:02:00 -04:00

Hi Anita — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for signing up and for the availability windows. Happy to run a focused 30-minute session that covers: sandbox key + quick end-to-end call, IP allowlist options, performance expectations for compact payloads, and a short troubleshooting pass.

I can offer these compact windows (all EDT):
- Mon 5/24 10:30–11:00am — tentative (hold for you)
- Tue 5/25 2:00–2:30pm — preferred for eng presence
- Wed 5/26 9:00–9:30am — fallback

Before we lock the invite, two quick preflight items that speed up the session:
- Please complete the attached FreshCart_Sandbox_Request_Form.pdf (stub) with your primary test domain and public IPs to allow-list.
- If you want to run test calls beforehand, reply with the preferred contact and we'll issue a time-limited sandbox key (TTL 72h).

If Tue 2pm works, reply "CONFIRM TUE 2PM" and I'll send a calendar invite. If you'd rather pick a slot by clicking a link, here's a quick scheduler: https://cal.redwood.ai/soojin/30m?slot=3

Diego (cc) will join the session as the technical backup for any low-level questions on header routing or KV cache behavior.

Attachment: redwood-quickstart-steps.md (short step list)

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference

I'll attach a signed copy of the sandbox request form after I fill it out (sending in a follow-up).

— Anita
